productQualityProblem: The historical incumbent produces 58 false positives and 85 false negatives, while the only short-event labeled development slice has 19 rows and cannot support label-wise tuning. The model needs short-event exposure without repeating MLM DAPT or forcing uncertain pseudo labels.
hypothesis: Exact-output consensus between the frozen incumbent and the fixed domain-restoration research checkpoint can identify a conservative subset of admitted short Events with high-confidence Product-18 positives, negatives, and abstentions. Selective masked distillation on that subset may improve short-event decision stability while avoiding the false-positive growth seen in MLM DAPT.

admissibleTrainingText.hippocorpus: all 2637 prepared train rows; ADMIT_UNLABELED; PRIMARY_FIRST_PERSON_EVENT
admissibleTrainingText.unexpectedEvents: 2637 prepared train rows selected without labels by deterministic participant round-robin; ADMIT_UNLABELED; AUXILIARY_HYPOTHETICAL_EVENT
admissibleTrainingText.sourceBalance: 1:1 row cap so the larger hypothetical corpus cannot dominate
admissibleTrainingText.validationExclusion: Both prepared validation splits remain untouched until a candidate exists

pseudoLabelPolicy.agreement: teachers must produce exactly the same selected output
pseudoLabelPolicy.positiveConfidence: minimum probability across both teachers >= 0.70 for every selected label
pseudoLabelPolicy.negativeConfidence: maximum probability across both teachers <= 0.10 for a label
pseudoLabelPolicy.confidentAbstention: both teachers select zero labels and every Product-18 probability from both teachers <= 0.10
pseudoLabelPolicy.uncertainLabels: masked; never forced positive or negative

feasibilityFailure: If any fixed coverage criterion fails, do not train and do not relax confidence thresholds.

candidateTrainingIfFeasible.runtimeLengthNote: 512 tokens is safety only; all admitted texts are complete and <=300 characters
candidateTrainingIfFeasible.loss: masked BCE on only strong consensus positives and negatives
candidateTrainingIfFeasible.modelUpdates: classifier plus top two encoder layers only

candidateSuccessCriteria.historicalDevelopment: micro-F1 >= incumbent 0.528052805280528, false positives <=58, false negatives <=85, and no supported-label F1 regression worse than 0.05
candidateSuccessCriteria.shortDevelopmentSlice: false positives <=5 and micro-F1 regression no worse than 0.02; descriptive guard only
candidateSuccessCriteria.untouchedUnlabeledValidations: no output collapse; each source exact-output agreement with incumbent >=0.85 and 0/1/2 distribution changes <=0.08 absolute per bin
candidateSuccessCriteria.decision: RETAIN_FOR_RESEARCH only if every guard passes; otherwise REJECT

promotionStatus: INCONCLUSIVE regardless of outcome because no independent rights-cleared Product-18 human gold exists
